units.source_text: 树木之清新，大概是由于城市幽雅和清扫干净的缘故。

en.t: The freshness of the trees was probably due to the city's quiet elegance and its clean, well-swept streets.

units.source_text: 在祇园一带，走进僻静的小胡同里，虽有成排昏暗陈旧的小房子，路面却并不脏。

en.t: Around Gion, if one stepped into a secluded little alley, there might be rows of dim, old houses, but the road surface was not dirty.
